from jinja2 import Environment
import pytest

@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_custom_filter_with_slice_async_true():
    jinja_env = Environment(enable_async=True)
    jinja_env.filters.update({'add_two': lambda x, y: [i + y for i in x]})
    template = jinja_env.from_string("{% for item in (a.b|add_two(5))[:1] %}{{ item }}{% endfor %}")
    data = {'a': {'b': [1, 2, 3]}}
    result = await template.render_async(data)
    assert result == "6"
